n: SMILE LLM project (Phi-2 on Raspberry Pi 5)
t: A project for a portable offline AI tutor on a Raspberry Pi 5.
steps: Find the SMILE LLM project page from Seeds of Empowerment.
Contact the project to ask for install steps.
Ask whether a code repository exists.
Ask IT whether the school can obtain a Raspberry Pi 5 with 8 GB of RAM.
Wait for confirmed steps before planning a class.
